rules.quote: Each transfer shifts one byte out on o_mosi and one byte in from i_miso.
rules.statement: Each transfer shifts one byte out on o_mosi and one byte in from i_miso.

rules.quote: Software sends the bytes to transmit through a valid/ready command stream and gets back each received byte through a valid/ready response stream, in order.
rules.statement: Received bytes are returned on the response stream in order, one per transmitted command byte.

rules.quote: The block never drops a received byte: when the response stream is back-pressured, the master stops starting new transfers.
rules.statement: The master never drops a received byte.

rules.quote: The block never drops a received byte: when the response stream is back-pressured, the master stops starting new transfers.
rules.condition: when the response stream is back-pressured
rules.statement: The master stops starting new transfers while the response stream is back-pressured.

rules.quote: One 8-bit transfer per command, MSB first, full duplex.
rules.statement: Each command produces one 8-bit full-duplex transfer, MSB first.

rules.quote: Bursts of any length: i_cmd_last = 1 marks the last byte of a burst. o_cs_n stays low for the whole burst.
rules.statement: i_cmd_last = 1 marks the last byte of a burst, and o_cs_n stays low for the whole burst.

rules.quote: SPI modes 0 to 3 are selected by i_cpol and i_cpha.
rules.statement: SPI modes 0 to 3 are selected by i_cpol and i_cpha.

rules.quote: They are captured when a burst starts.
rules.statement: i_cpol and i_cpha are captured when a burst starts.

rules.quote: SCLK frequency is f(i_clk) / (2 x PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV), with PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV from 1 to 255 (fixed at elaboration).
rules.condition: PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV from 1 to 255, fixed at elaboration
rules.statement: SCLK frequency is f(i_clk) / (2 x PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV).

rules.quote: Slave-select timing in half periods: lead time, trail time and minimum high time between bursts.
rules.statement: Slave-select timing provides lead time, trail time and minimum high time between bursts, measured in half periods.

rules.quote: Back-to-back bytes inside a burst have no SCLK gap when the next command is ready in time.
rules.condition: back-to-back bytes inside a burst when the next command is ready in time
rules.statement: There is no SCLK gap between back-to-back bytes.

rules.quote: Otherwise SCLK pauses at its idle level and o_cs_n stays low.
rules.condition: inside a burst when the next command is not ready in time
rules.statement: SCLK pauses at its idle level and o_cs_n stays low.

rules.quote: No received byte is lost under back-pressure: one byte is shown on the response stream and at most one more is held inside the master.
rules.statement: No received byte is lost: one byte is shown on the response stream and at most one more is held inside the master.

rules.quote: Asynchronous active-low reset.
rules.statement: Reset is asynchronous and active-low.

rules.quote: Term: Transfer; Meaning: Shifting one byte out and one byte in for one accepted command. A transfer whose command is accepted at edge A covers the 16·D cycles starting at edges A to A + 16·D − 1.
rules.condition: A command is accepted at edge A
rules.statement: A transfer whose command is accepted at edge A covers 16·D i_clk cycles, starting at edges A through A + 16·D − 1.

rules.quote: Term: SCLK edge k; Meaning: For a transfer with acceptance edge A, the k-th transition of o_sclk (k = 1 to 16). It happens at edge A + k·D.
rules.condition: During a transfer with acceptance edge A, for k = 1 to 16
rules.statement: The k-th transition of o_sclk (SCLK edge k) happens at edge A + k·D.

rules.quote: Term: Leading / trailing edge; Meaning: The odd SCLK edges (k = 1, 3, …, 15) are leading edges, which leave the idle level. The even SCLK edges (k = 2, 4, …, 16) are trailing edges, which return to the idle level.
rules.statement: Odd SCLK edges (k = 1, 3, …, 15) leave the idle level of o_sclk. Even SCLK edges (k = 2, 4, …, 16) return o_sclk to the idle level.

rules.quote: Term: CPOL_b, CPHA_b; Meaning: The values of i_cpol and i_cpha captured at the first acceptance edge of the current burst.
rules.statement: The values of i_cpol and i_cpha captured at the first acceptance edge of the burst (CPOL_b, CPHA_b) apply for the current burst.

rules.quote: Term: Pause; Meaning: Phase inside a burst after a transfer with i_cmd_last = 0 ended, when no command was accepted at its SCLK edge 16. o_cs_n = 0 and o_sclk is at the idle level.
rules.condition: In a pause: inside a burst after a transfer with i_cmd_last = 0 ended and no command was accepted at its SCLK edge 16
rules.statement: o_cs_n is 0 and o_sclk is at the idle level.

rules.quote: Term: Trail; Meaning: The D cycles after SCLK edge 16 of the last transfer of a burst, before o_cs_n goes high.
rules.condition: After SCLK edge 16 of the last transfer of a burst
rules.statement: o_cs_n stays low for a trail of D cycles after SCLK edge 16 before going high.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV; Default: 4; Legal values: 1 to 255; Description: Number of i_clk cycles in one SCLK half period (D). SCLK frequency = f(i_clk) / (2·D).
rules.statement: PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV shall take a legal value from 1 to 255 (default 4), being the number of i_clk cycles in one SCLK half period D.

rules.quote: Parameter: PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV; Default: 4; Legal values: 1 to 255; Description: Number of i_clk cycles in one SCLK half period (D). SCLK frequency = f(i_clk) / (2·D).
rules.statement: SCLK frequency shall equal f(i_clk) / (2·D), where D is PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV i_clk cycles per SCLK half period.

rules.quote: [REQ-PAR-001] Elaboration of m_spi_master shall fail with an error message when PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV is less than 1 or greater than 255.
rules.condition: When PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV is less than 1 or greater than 255
rules.statement: Elaboration of m_spi_master shall fail with an error message.

rules.quote: [REQ-PAR-002] Every value of PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV from 1 to 255 shall give the behaviour of this specification without any other change to the RTL.
rules.condition: For every PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV value from 1 to 255
rules.statement: m_spi_master shall exhibit the specified behaviour without any other RTL change.

rules.quote: Port: i_rst_n; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Reset (asynchronous assertion, synchronous release); Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Active-low reset
rules.statement: i_rst_n is active-low, asserted asynchronously and released synchronously to i_clk.

rules.quote: Port: i_cmd_valid; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Command stream valid. The environment keeps it 0 while i_rst_n = 0
rules.statement: The environment keeps i_cmd_valid at 0 while i_rst_n = 0.

rules.quote: Port: i_cmd_valid; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Command stream valid. The environment keeps it 0 while i_rst_n = 0
rules.statement: i_cmd_valid has reset value 0.

rules.quote: Port: o_cmd_ready; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 1; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Command stream ready. Does not depend combinationally on any input
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready has reset value 1.

rules.quote: Port: o_cmd_ready; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 1; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Command stream ready. Does not depend combinationally on any input
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready must not depend combinationally on any input.

rules.quote: Port: i_cmd_data; Direction: input; Width: 8; Signal type: Data; Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Byte to send. Captured at the command handshake
rules.statement: i_cmd_data is captured at the command handshake as the byte to send.

rules.quote: Port: i_cmd_last; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: 1 = this byte ends the burst, and o_cs_n is released after it. Captured at the command handshake
rules.condition: i_cmd_last = 1 captured at the command handshake
rules.statement: i_cmd_last is captured at the command handshake; when 1, the byte ends the burst and o_cs_n is released after it.

rules.quote: Port: o_rsp_valid; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Response stream valid
rules.statement: o_rsp_valid has reset value 0.

rules.quote: Port: o_rsp_data; Direction: output; Width: 8; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Byte received during the transfer of the matching command
rules.statement: o_rsp_data carries the byte received during the transfer of the matching command.

rules.quote: Port: o_rsp_data; Direction: output; Width: 8; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: Byte received during the transfer of the matching command
rules.statement: o_rsp_data has reset value 0.

rules.quote: Port: o_sclk; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data (SPI serial clock; not used as a clock inside the block); Reset value: Equal to i_cpol (follows it combinationally); Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: SPI serial clock
rules.statement: o_sclk equals i_cpol, following it combinationally, in reset.

rules.quote: Port: o_mosi; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 0; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: SPI master-out slave-in data
rules.statement: o_mosi has reset value 0.

rules.quote: Port: o_cs_n; Direction: output; Width: 1; Signal type: Data; Reset value: 1; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: SPI slave select, active low
rules.statement: o_cs_n has reset value 1.

rules.quote: Port: i_cpol; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Data (quasi-static configuration); Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: SPI clock polarity (SCLK idle level). May change only while o_cs_n = 1
rules.statement: i_cpol may change only while o_cs_n = 1.

rules.quote: Port: i_cpha; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Data (quasi-static configuration); Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: SPI clock phase. 0 = sample on leading edges, 1 = sample on trailing edges. May change only while o_cs_n = 1
rules.statement: i_cpha = 0 samples on leading edges and i_cpha = 1 samples on trailing edges.

rules.quote: Port: i_cpha; Direction: input; Width: 1; Signal type: Data (quasi-static configuration); Reset value: Not applicable; Clock domain: CLK; Meaning: SPI clock phase. 0 = sample on leading edges, 1 = sample on trailing edges. May change only while o_cs_n = 1
rules.statement: i_cpha may change only while o_cs_n = 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-CLK-001] All state elements of m_spi_master shall be clocked by the rising edge of i_clk, which is the only clock of the block (domain CLK).
rules.statement: All state elements of m_spi_master shall be clocked by the rising edge of i_clk, the only clock of the block.

rules.quote: [REQ-CLK-002] o_sclk shall be produced as a data output timed by i_clk and shall not clock any state element inside the block.
rules.statement: o_sclk shall be produced as a data output timed by i_clk.

rules.quote: [REQ-CLK-002] o_sclk shall be produced as a data output timed by i_clk and shall not clock any state element inside the block.
rules.statement: o_sclk shall not clock any state element inside the block.

rules.quote: [REQ-CLK-003] i_miso shall be treated as synchronous to i_clk and shall be sampled without a synchroniser, because the slave launches it from o_sclk, which is derived from i_clk.
rules.statement: i_miso shall be treated as synchronous to i_clk and sampled without a synchroniser.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-001] When i_rst_n changes to 0, all outputs shall take their reset values at once, without waiting for an edge of i_clk.
rules.statement: All outputs shall take their reset values at once, without waiting for an edge of i_clk.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-002] While i_rst_n = 0, o_cs_n shall be 1.
rules.statement: o_cs_n shall be 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-003] While i_rst_n = 0, o_sclk shall be equal to the current value of i_cpol and shall follow every change of i_cpol combinationally.
rules.statement: o_sclk shall equal the current value of i_cpol and follow every change of i_cpol combinationally.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-004] While i_rst_n = 0, o_mosi shall be 0.
rules.statement: o_mosi shall be 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-005] While i_rst_n = 0, o_rsp_valid shall be 0 and o_rsp_data shall be 8'h00.
rules.statement: o_rsp_valid shall be 0 and o_rsp_data shall be 8'h00.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-006] While i_rst_n = 0, o_cmd_ready shall be 1.
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready shall be 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-007] While i_rst_n = 0, the master shall not accept a command, whatever the values of i_cmd_valid and o_cmd_ready.
rules.condition: While i_rst_n = 0, whatever the values of i_cmd_valid and o_cmd_ready
rules.statement: The master shall not accept a command.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-008] Reset asserted during a burst shall abort the transfer in progress, and no response shall be produced for that transfer.
rules.statement: The transfer in progress shall be aborted.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-008] Reset asserted during a burst shall abort the transfer in progress, and no response shall be produced for that transfer.
rules.statement: No response shall be produced for the aborted transfer.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-009] Reset asserted while a shown byte or a held byte exists shall discard that byte without a response handshake.
rules.condition: Reset asserted while a shown byte or a held byte exists
rules.statement: That byte shall be discarded without a response handshake.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-010] After i_rst_n returns to 1, the master shall be in Idle with the gap requirement met: it can accept a command at the first edge at which i_rst_n is 1.
rules.statement: The master shall be in Idle with the gap requirement met and able to accept a command at the first edge at which i_rst_n is 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-RST-011] The minimum o_cs_n high time of REQ-CS-005 shall not be required across a reset: the high time of o_cs_n after an aborted burst is the reset duration plus the time until the next acceptance.
rules.statement: The minimum o_cs_n high time of REQ-CS-005 shall not be required; after an aborted burst the high time is the reset duration plus time until next acceptance.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-001] The master shall accept a command at an edge only when i_rst_n = 1, i_cmd_valid = 1 and o_cmd_ready = 1 at that edge.
rules.statement: The master accepts a command at an edge only when i_rst_n = 1, i_cmd_valid = 1 and o_cmd_ready = 1 at that edge.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-002] At the acceptance edge the master shall capture i_cmd_data as the byte to send and i_cmd_last as the end-of-burst flag of that transfer.
rules.statement: The master captures i_cmd_data as the byte to send and i_cmd_last as the end-of-burst flag of that transfer.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-003] The values of i_cmd_data and i_cmd_last at edges without a command handshake shall have no effect.
rules.condition: At edges without a command handshake
rules.statement: Values of i_cmd_data and i_cmd_last have no effect.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-004] If i_cmd_valid goes from 1 to 0 without a command handshake, the master shall behave as if the command had never been presented.
rules.condition: i_cmd_valid goes from 1 to 0 without a command handshake
rules.statement: The master behaves as if the command had never been presented.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-005] o_cmd_ready shall change only at an edge of i_clk or when i_rst_n is asserted, and shall not depend combinationally on any input.
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready changes only at an i_clk edge or when i_rst_n is asserted, and does not depend combinationally on any input.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-006] While i_rst_n = 1, o_cmd_ready shall be 0 in every cycle in which o_rsp_valid = 1.
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready is 0 in every cycle in which o_rsp_valid = 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-007] When o_cs_n changes from 0 to 1 at edge R, o_cmd_ready shall be 0 in every cycle that starts at an edge from R to R + D − 2. When D = 1 there is no such cycle.
rules.condition: o_cs_n changes from 0 to 1 at edge R
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready is 0 in every cycle starting at an edge from R to R + D − 2 (no such cycle when D = 1).

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-008] In Idle, o_cmd_ready shall be 1 when o_rsp_valid = 0 in every cycle that starts at edge R + D − 1 or later, and in every cycle after reset release until the next acceptance.
rules.condition: In Idle with o_rsp_valid = 0, from edge R + D − 1 onward, and after reset release until the next acceptance
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready is 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-009] During a transfer, o_cmd_ready shall be 0 in every cycle except the last cycle of the transfer.
rules.condition: During a transfer, except its last cycle
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready is 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-010] In the last cycle of a transfer, o_cmd_ready shall be 1 if the i_cmd_last captured for that transfer is 0 and o_rsp_valid is 0, and 0 otherwise.
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready is 1 if the captured i_cmd_last is 0 and o_rsp_valid is 0, and 0 otherwise.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-011] In Pause, o_cmd_ready shall be 1 when o_rsp_valid = 0 and 0 when o_rsp_valid = 1.
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready is 1 when o_rsp_valid = 0 and 0 when o_rsp_valid = 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-CMD-012] In Trail, o_cmd_ready shall be 0.
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready is 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-CS-001] A command accepted in Idle at edge A shall start a burst: o_cs_n shall change from 1 to 0 at edge A.
rules.condition: Command accepted in Idle at edge A
rules.statement: o_cs_n changes from 1 to 0 at edge A, starting a burst.

rules.quote: [REQ-CS-002] o_cs_n shall stay 0 from the start of a burst until edge A + 17·D, where A is the acceptance edge of the transfer whose captured i_cmd_last is 1. At that edge o_cs_n shall change to 1.
rules.condition: From burst start; A is the acceptance edge of the transfer with captured i_cmd_last = 1
rules.statement: o_cs_n stays 0 until edge A + 17·D, where it changes to 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-CS-003] o_cs_n shall change only at the edges given in REQ-CS-001 and REQ-CS-002, and at the assertion of i_rst_n.
rules.statement: o_cs_n changes only at the edges given in REQ-CS-001 and REQ-CS-002 and at the assertion of i_rst_n.

rules.quote: [REQ-CS-004] The first SCLK edge of a burst shall come exactly D cycles after o_cs_n falls (edge A + D), so the lead time is one SCLK half period.
rules.statement: The first SCLK edge of a burst comes exactly D cycles after o_cs_n falls (edge A + D).

rules.quote: [REQ-CS-005] Between two bursts with no reset in between, o_cs_n shall stay 1 for at least D cycles.
rules.condition: Between two bursts with no reset in between
rules.statement: o_cs_n stays 1 for at least D cycles.

rules.quote: [REQ-CS-006] o_cs_n shall rise exactly D cycles after SCLK edge 16 of the last transfer of the burst, so the trail time is one SCLK half period.
rules.statement: o_cs_n rises exactly D cycles after SCLK edge 16 of the last transfer of the burst.

rules.quote: [REQ-CS-007] The rise of o_cs_n at the end of a burst shall not depend on the state of the response stream (o_rsp_valid, i_rsp_ready, a held byte).
rules.statement: The rise of o_cs_n does not depend on the response stream state (o_rsp_valid, i_rsp_ready, a held byte).

rules.quote: [REQ-MODE-001] At the acceptance edge of the first command of a burst, the master shall capture i_cpol as CPOL_b and i_cpha as CPHA_b.
rules.condition: Acceptance edge of the first command of a burst
rules.statement: The master captures i_cpol as CPOL_b and i_cpha as CPHA_b.

rules.quote: [REQ-MODE-002] CPOL_b and CPHA_b shall control o_sclk, o_mosi and the sampling of i_miso for the whole burst, including Pause and Trail.
rules.condition: Whole burst, including Pause and Trail
rules.statement: CPOL_b and CPHA_b control o_sclk, o_mosi and the sampling of i_miso.

rules.quote: [REQ-MODE-003] Changes of i_cpol or i_cpha while o_cs_n = 0 shall have no effect on o_sclk, o_mosi, o_cs_n, the sampling of i_miso or the response data.
rules.statement: Changes of i_cpol or i_cpha have no effect on o_sclk, o_mosi, o_cs_n, i_miso sampling or response data.

rules.quote: [REQ-MODE-004] With CPHA_b = 0, the leading SCLK edges (odd k) shall be the sampling edges and the trailing SCLK edges (even k) shall be the shift edges.
rules.statement: Leading SCLK edges (odd k) are sampling edges and trailing edges (even k) are shift edges.

rules.quote: [REQ-MODE-005] With CPHA_b = 1, the leading SCLK edges (odd k) shall be the shift edges and the trailing SCLK edges (even k) shall be the sampling edges.
rules.statement: Leading SCLK edges (odd k) are shift edges and trailing edges (even k) are sampling edges.

rules.quote: [REQ-SCLK-001] For a transfer with acceptance edge A, o_sclk shall toggle at each of the 16 edges A + k·D, k = 1 to 16.
rules.statement: o_sclk toggles at each of the 16 edges A + k·D, k = 1 to 16.

rules.quote: [REQ-SCLK-002] While o_cs_n = 0, o_sclk shall not change at any edge other than those of REQ-SCLK-001.
rules.statement: o_sclk does not change at any edge other than A + k·D, k = 1 to 16.

rules.quote: [REQ-SCLK-003] While o_cs_n = 0 and no transfer is between its SCLK edges 1 and 16, o_sclk shall equal CPOL_b. This covers the lead half period, Pause and Trail.
rules.condition: o_cs_n = 0 and no transfer is between its SCLK edges 1 and 16
rules.statement: o_sclk equals CPOL_b (lead half period, Pause, Trail).

rules.quote: [REQ-SCLK-004] After SCLK edge k of a transfer, o_sclk shall equal NOT CPOL_b for odd k and CPOL_b for even k.
rules.condition: After SCLK edge k of a transfer
rules.statement: o_sclk equals NOT CPOL_b for odd k and CPOL_b for even k.

rules.quote: [REQ-SCLK-005] While o_cs_n = 1, o_sclk shall equal i_cpol and shall follow changes of i_cpol combinationally.
rules.statement: o_sclk equals i_cpol and follows changes of i_cpol combinationally.

rules.quote: [REQ-SCLK-006] When o_cs_n rises at edge R, o_sclk shall take the value of i_cpol from edge R on.
rules.statement: o_sclk takes the value of i_cpol from edge R on.

rules.quote: [REQ-SCLK-007] When a transfer starts at SCLK edge 16 of the previous transfer of the same burst, the SCLK period over the joint shall be 2·D cycles with each half period equal to D cycles.
rules.condition: Transfer starts at SCLK edge 16 of the previous transfer of the same burst
rules.statement: The SCLK period over the joint is 2·D cycles with each half period D cycles.

rules.quote: [REQ-MOSI-001] The bits of each byte shall be sent in the order d[7], d[6], …, d[0] (MSB first).
rules.statement: Bits of each byte are sent MSB first: d[7], d[6], …, d[0].

rules.quote: [REQ-MOSI-002] With CPHA_b = 0, o_mosi shall take the value d[7] at the acceptance edge A.
rules.statement: o_mosi takes the value d[7] at the acceptance edge A.

rules.quote: [REQ-MOSI-003] With CPHA_b = 0, o_mosi shall take the value d[7 − j] at edge A + 2·j·D for j = 1 to 7 (SCLK edges 2, 4, …, 14).
rules.statement: o_mosi takes the value d[7 − j] at edge A + 2·j·D for j = 1 to 7.

rules.quote: [REQ-MOSI-004] With CPHA_b = 1, o_mosi shall take the value d[7 − j] at edge A + (2·j + 1)·D for j = 0 to 7 (SCLK edges 1, 3, …, 15).
rules.statement: o_mosi takes the value d[7 − j] at edge A + (2·j + 1)·D for j = 0 to 7.

rules.quote: [REQ-MOSI-005] o_mosi shall not change at any edge other than those of REQ-MOSI-002 to REQ-MOSI-004, except at the assertion of i_rst_n.
rules.statement: o_mosi does not change at any edge other than those of REQ-MOSI-002 to REQ-MOSI-004, except at the assertion of i_rst_n.

rules.quote: [REQ-MOSI-006] In Idle, Pause and Trail, o_mosi shall keep the last value it was given. That value is 0 after reset.
rules.statement: o_mosi keeps the last value it was given, which is 0 after reset.

rules.quote: [REQ-MOSI-007] o_mosi shall be stable in the cycle before each sampling edge and shall not change at any sampling edge, in all four modes.
rules.statement: o_mosi is stable in the cycle before each sampling edge and does not change at any sampling edge.

rules.quote: With CPHA_b = 0, o_mosi keeps d[0] after SCLK edge 16 unless the next command is accepted at that edge, in which case it takes the next d[7] at that edge (REQ-MOSI-002).
rules.statement: o_mosi keeps d[0] unless the next command is accepted at that edge, in which case it takes the next d[7].

rules.quote: With CPHA_b = 1, o_mosi keeps its previous value from the acceptance edge until SCLK edge 1.
rules.statement: o_mosi keeps its previous value from the acceptance edge until SCLK edge 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-MISO-001] With CPHA_b = 0, the master shall capture i_miso as received bit r[7 − j] at edge A + (2·j + 1)·D for j = 0 to 7.
rules.statement: The master captures i_miso as r[7 − j] at edge A + (2·j + 1)·D for j = 0 to 7.

rules.quote: [REQ-MISO-002] With CPHA_b = 1, the master shall capture i_miso as received bit r[7 − j] at edge A + (2·j + 2)·D for j = 0 to 7.
rules.statement: The master captures i_miso as r[7 − j] at edge A + (2·j + 2)·D for j = 0 to 7.

rules.quote: [REQ-MISO-003] The value captured at a sampling edge shall be the value of i_miso in the cycle that ends at that edge, which is the value just before o_sclk makes the sampling transition.
rules.statement: The captured value is i_miso in the cycle ending at that edge, just before o_sclk makes the sampling transition.

rules.quote: [REQ-MISO-004] i_miso shall have no effect at any edge other than the sampling edges of a transfer.
rules.condition: At edges other than sampling edges of a transfer
rules.statement: i_miso has no effect.

rules.quote: [REQ-MISO-005] The received byte r[7:0] of a transfer shall be made of the 8 bits captured during that transfer only.
rules.statement: The received byte r[7:0] of a transfer is made only of the 8 bits captured during that transfer.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-001] Each accepted command shall produce exactly one response carrying the byte received during its transfer.
rules.statement: Each accepted command produces exactly one response carrying the byte received during its transfer.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-002] Responses shall be delivered in the order in which the commands were accepted, across burst boundaries.
rules.statement: Responses are delivered in command acceptance order, across burst boundaries.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-003] At edge A + 16·D of a transfer, the master shall load the received byte into o_rsp_data and set o_rsp_valid to 1 if o_rsp_valid was 0 in the cycle ending at that edge or a response handshake occurs at that edge.
rules.condition: At edge A + 16·D, if o_rsp_valid was 0 in the cycle ending at that edge or a response handshake occurs
rules.statement: The master loads the received byte into o_rsp_data and sets o_rsp_valid to 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-004] If neither condition of REQ-RSP-003 holds at edge A + 16·D, the received byte shall become the held byte.
rules.condition: At edge A + 16·D, neither condition of REQ-RSP-003 holds
rules.statement: The received byte becomes the held byte.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-005] At the edge where the response handshake of the shown byte occurs, the held byte shall be loaded into o_rsp_data and o_rsp_valid shall stay 1.
rules.condition: At the edge of the response handshake of the shown byte, with a held byte
rules.statement: The held byte is loaded into o_rsp_data and o_rsp_valid stays 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-006] At a response handshake where no byte is loaded at the same edge, o_rsp_valid shall change to 0.
rules.condition: Response handshake with no byte loaded at the same edge
rules.statement: o_rsp_valid changes to 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-007] While o_rsp_valid = 1 and no response handshake has occurred, o_rsp_valid shall stay 1 and o_rsp_data shall not change.
rules.statement: o_rsp_valid stays 1 and o_rsp_data does not change.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-008] While o_rsp_valid = 0, o_rsp_data shall keep the last byte loaded into it, or 8'h00 after reset.
rules.statement: o_rsp_data keeps the last byte loaded into it, or 8'h00 after reset.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-009] o_rsp_valid and o_rsp_data shall change only at edges of i_clk or at the assertion of i_rst_n.
rules.statement: o_rsp_valid and o_rsp_data change only at i_clk edges or at the assertion of i_rst_n.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-010] i_rsp_ready shall have no effect while o_rsp_valid = 0.
rules.statement: i_rsp_ready has no effect.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-011] The master shall never overwrite a shown byte or a held byte before it has been taken, and shall never deliver a byte twice.
rules.statement: The master never overwrites a shown or held byte before it has been taken and never delivers a byte twice.

rules.quote: [REQ-RSP-012] At any time, at most two received bytes shall be pending: one shown byte and at most one held byte.
rules.statement: At most two received bytes are pending at any time: one shown byte and at most one held byte.

rules.quote: A new transfer therefore starts only when every earlier received byte has been taken, except the byte of the transfer that ends at the same edge.
rules.statement: A new transfer starts only when every earlier received byte has been taken, except the byte of the transfer ending at the same edge.

rules.section_title: Continuation, pause and end of burst
rules.quote: [REQ-FLOW-001] When a command is accepted at edge A + 16·D of a transfer whose captured i_cmd_last is 0, the new transfer shall use that edge as its acceptance edge. Its SCLK edge 1 then comes D cycles after SCLK edge 16 of the previous transfer, with no gap.
rules.condition: Command accepted at edge A + 16·D of a transfer with captured i_cmd_last = 0
rules.statement: The new transfer uses that edge as its acceptance edge, with SCLK edge 1 D cycles after previous SCLK edge 16.

rules.section_title: Continuation, pause and end of burst
rules.quote: [REQ-FLOW-002] When a transfer with captured i_cmd_last = 0 ends at edge A + 16·D without a command handshake at that edge, the master shall enter Pause.
rules.condition: Transfer with captured i_cmd_last = 0 ends at edge A + 16·D without a command handshake
rules.statement: The master enters Pause.

rules.section_title: Continuation, pause and end of burst
rules.quote: [REQ-FLOW-003] In Pause, o_cs_n shall stay 0, o_sclk shall stay at CPOL_b and o_mosi shall keep its value.
rules.statement: o_cs_n stays 0, o_sclk stays at CPOL_b and o_mosi keeps its value.

rules.section_title: Continuation, pause and end of burst
rules.quote: [REQ-FLOW-004] Pause shall last until a command is accepted, without any time limit.
rules.statement: Pause lasts until a command is accepted, without any time limit.

rules.section_title: Continuation, pause and end of burst
rules.quote: [REQ-FLOW-005] A command accepted in Pause at edge P shall start a transfer with acceptance edge A = P, in the same burst and with the same CPOL_b and CPHA_b.
rules.condition: Command accepted in Pause at edge P
rules.statement: A transfer starts with acceptance edge A = P, in the same burst with the same CPOL_b and CPHA_b.

rules.section_title: Continuation, pause and end of burst
rules.quote: [REQ-FLOW-006] When a transfer with captured i_cmd_last = 1 ends at edge A + 16·D, the master shall enter Trail, and o_cs_n shall rise at edge A + 17·D (REQ-CS-002).
rules.condition: Transfer with captured i_cmd_last = 1 ends at edge A + 16·D
rules.statement: The master enters Trail and o_cs_n rises at edge A + 17·D.

rules.section_title: Continuation, pause and end of burst
rules.quote: [REQ-FLOW-007] The master shall not start a transfer while a received byte is held.
rules.statement: The master does not start a transfer.

rules.quote: Latency and throughput (D = PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV, all numbers in i_clk cycles): Item: Command acceptance to SCLK edge 1 (lead); Value: D
rules.statement: SCLK edge 1 (lead) must occur D i_clk cycles after command acceptance, where D = PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV.

rules.quote: Latency and throughput (D = PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV, all numbers in i_clk cycles): Item: Command acceptance to o_cs_n low (first byte of a burst); Value: 0 (same edge A)
rules.statement: o_cs_n must go low at the acceptance edge itself (0 cycles after command acceptance) for the first byte of a burst.

rules.quote: Latency and throughput (D = PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV, all numbers in i_clk cycles): Item: Command acceptance to o_rsp_valid = 1 (response register free); Value: 16·D
rules.statement: o_rsp_valid must become 1 16·D i_clk cycles after command acceptance.

rules.quote: Latency and throughput (D = PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV, all numbers in i_clk cycles): Item: SCLK edge 16 of last byte to o_cs_n high (trail); Value: D
rules.condition: After SCLK edge 16 of last byte
rules.statement: o_cs_n must go high D i_clk cycles after SCLK edge 16 of the last byte (trail).

rules.quote: Latency and throughput (D = PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV, all numbers in i_clk cycles): Item: Minimum o_cs_n high time between bursts (gap); Value: D
rules.statement: o_cs_n must stay high for at least D i_clk cycles between bursts.

rules.quote: Latency and throughput (D = PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV, all numbers in i_clk cycles): Item: Byte period inside a continuous burst; Value: 16·D
rules.statement: Byte period inside a continuous burst must be 16·D i_clk cycles.

rules.quote: Latency and throughput (D = PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV, all numbers in i_clk cycles): Item: o_cs_n low time of an n-byte continuous burst; Value: 16·n·D + D
rules.statement: o_cs_n low time of an n-byte continuous burst must be 16·n·D + D i_clk cycles.

rules.quote: Latency and throughput (D = PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV, all numbers in i_clk cycles): Item: Minimum time between first acceptances of consecutive n-byte bursts; Value: 16·n·D + 2·D
rules.statement: Minimum time between first acceptances of consecutive n-byte bursts must be 16·n·D + 2·D i_clk cycles.

rules.quote: Item: Minimum period of single-byte bursts (i_cmd_last always 1); Value: 18·D
rules.statement: The minimum period of single-byte bursts must be 18·D i_clk cycles.

rules.quote: Conditions for a continuous burst (no SCLK pause): The next command must be valid in the last cycle of the current transfer.
rules.condition: For a continuous burst without SCLK pause
rules.statement: The next command must be valid in the last cycle of the current transfer.

rules.quote: Conditions for a continuous burst (no SCLK pause): o_rsp_valid must be 0 in that cycle. This means the response of the previous transfer was taken within 16·D − 1 cycles of becoming valid, for example with i_rsp_ready held at 1.
rules.condition: For a continuous burst without SCLK pause
rules.statement: o_rsp_valid must be 0 in the last cycle of the current transfer, so the previous response must be taken within 16·D − 1 cycles of becoming valid.

rules.quote: Back-pressure: If o_rsp_valid = 1 in the last cycle of a transfer, the next transfer is not started at its SCLK edge 16.
rules.condition: o_rsp_valid = 1 in the last cycle of a transfer
rules.statement: The next transfer must not start at SCLK edge 16.

rules.quote: The burst enters Pause (or Trail if it was the last byte).
rules.condition: o_rsp_valid = 1 in the last cycle of a transfer
rules.statement: The burst must enter Pause, or Trail if it was the last byte.

rules.quote: If the shown byte has still not been taken at the end of a running transfer, that transfer's byte becomes the held byte.
rules.condition: Shown byte not yet taken at the end of a running transfer
rules.statement: That transfer's byte must become the held byte.

rules.quote: No new transfer starts until both bytes have been taken.
rules.condition: Until both shown and held bytes have been taken
rules.statement: No new transfer may start until both bytes have been taken.

rules.quote: Ordering: responses come out in command order (REQ-RSP-002).
rules.statement: Responses must come out in command order.

rules.quote: Example 3: back-pressure, any D. Byte N is shown at edge A_N + 16·D. Transfer N+1 starts at that edge. i_rsp_ready stays 0. At edge A_N + 32·D, byte N+1 becomes the held byte and the burst enters Pause (or Trail), because o_rsp_valid = 1 forced o_cmd_ready = 0 in the last cycle.
rules.condition: i_rsp_ready stays 0 after byte N is shown at A_N + 16·D
rules.statement: Transfer N+1 starts at that edge; at A_N + 32·D byte N+1 becomes held and the burst enters Pause or Trail because o_cmd_ready was forced 0.

rules.quote: When i_rsp_ready goes to 1, byte N is taken at edge H. Byte N+1 is loaded at H and o_rsp_valid stays 1. Byte N+1 is taken at edge H + 1. After that, o_cmd_ready returns to 1 in Pause.
rules.condition: Back-pressure with held byte, when i_rsp_ready goes to 1
rules.statement: Byte N is taken at edge H, byte N+1 is loaded at H with o_rsp_valid staying 1 and taken at H+1, then o_cmd_ready returns to 1 in Pause.

rules.quote: The block has no software-visible registers.
rules.statement: The spi_master block must not provide any software-visible registers.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-001] When i_cpol or i_cpha changes while o_cs_n = 0 (an environment violation), the master shall not detect or report it and shall keep using CPOL_b and CPHA_b until the end of the burst (REQ-MODE-003).
rules.condition: i_cpol or i_cpha changes while o_cs_n = 0
rules.statement: The master shall not detect or report a change of i_cpol or i_cpha while o_cs_n = 0.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-001] When i_cpol or i_cpha changes while o_cs_n = 0 (an environment violation), the master shall not detect or report it and shall keep using CPOL_b and CPHA_b until the end of the burst (REQ-MODE-003).
rules.condition: i_cpol or i_cpha changes while o_cs_n = 0
rules.statement: The master shall keep using CPOL_b and CPHA_b until the end of the burst.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-002] When i_cpol differs from CPOL_b at the edge where o_cs_n rises, o_sclk shall change to i_cpol at that edge (REQ-SCLK-006).
rules.condition: i_cpol differs from CPOL_b at the edge where o_cs_n rises
rules.statement: o_sclk shall change to i_cpol at the edge where o_cs_n rises.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-003] When i_cmd_valid = 1 while o_cmd_ready = 0, the command shall wait without effect until a command handshake occurs.
rules.statement: The command shall wait without effect until a command handshake occurs.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-004] When i_cmd_valid = 1 while i_rst_n = 0, the master shall not accept the command (REQ-RST-007).
rules.statement: The master shall not accept the command.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-005] When the response consumer never takes a response, the master shall keep o_rsp_valid = 1 with the same byte and shall not start any further transfer.
rules.condition: the response consumer never takes a response
rules.statement: The master shall keep o_rsp_valid = 1 with the same byte.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-005] When the response consumer never takes a response, the master shall keep o_rsp_valid = 1 with the same byte and shall not start any further transfer.
rules.condition: the response consumer never takes a response
rules.statement: The master shall not start any further transfer.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-006] When a burst is in Pause and no command ever arrives, o_cs_n shall stay 0 indefinitely.
rules.condition: a burst is in Pause and no command ever arrives
rules.statement: o_cs_n shall stay 0 indefinitely.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-007] When i_rst_n is asserted during a transfer, o_cs_n shall go to 1 and o_sclk to i_cpol at once, even in the middle of an SCLK half period, and the partial byte shall be discarded (REQ-RST-008).
rules.condition: i_rst_n is asserted during a transfer
rules.statement: o_cs_n shall go to 1 and o_sclk to i_cpol at once, even in the middle of an SCLK half period.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-007] When i_rst_n is asserted during a transfer, o_cs_n shall go to 1 and o_sclk to i_cpol at once, even in the middle of an SCLK half period, and the partial byte shall be discarded (REQ-RST-008).
rules.condition: i_rst_n is asserted during a transfer
rules.statement: The partial byte shall be discarded.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-008] When i_rst_n is asserted in Pause, Trail or the Idle gap, the master shall go to the reset state of REQ-RST-002 to REQ-RST-006, and pending bytes shall be discarded.
rules.condition: i_rst_n is asserted in Pause, Trail or the Idle gap
rules.statement: The master shall go to the reset state of REQ-RST-002 to REQ-RST-006.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-008] When i_rst_n is asserted in Pause, Trail or the Idle gap, the master shall go to the reset state of REQ-RST-002 to REQ-RST-006, and pending bytes shall be discarded.
rules.condition: i_rst_n is asserted in Pause, Trail or the Idle gap
rules.statement: Pending bytes shall be discarded.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-009] A response handshake at exactly edge A + 16·D of a transfer shall make the received byte of that transfer load into o_rsp_data at that edge, with o_rsp_valid staying 1 (REQ-RSP-003).
rules.condition: a response handshake occurs at exactly edge A + 16·D of a transfer
rules.statement: The received byte of that transfer shall load into o_rsp_data at that edge, with o_rsp_valid staying 1.

rules.quote: [REQ-ERR-010] A timing violation on i_miso (data changing too close to a sampling edge) shall not be detected.
rules.condition: a timing violation on i_miso occurs near a sampling edge
rules.statement: The master shall not detect a timing violation on i_miso.

rules.quote: Case: i_cmd_last = 0 forever; Behaviour: The burst never ends. o_cs_n stays 0 and transfers continue as commands arrive.
rules.statement: The burst never ends; o_cs_n stays 0 and transfers continue as commands arrive.

rules.quote: Case: D = 255; Behaviour: Each half period is 255 cycles and a byte takes 4080 cycles. The half-period count must reach 255 without overflow.
rules.statement: The half-period count shall reach 255 without overflow, giving 255-cycle half periods and 4080 cycles per byte.

rules.quote: ID: CFG-BASE; Parameter values: defaults (PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV=4); Purpose: Main configuration, all four SPI modes The verification runs every configuration listed here (run_set.json). The SPI mode is a run-time input, so each configuration runs all four modes.
rules.condition: for each configuration CFG-BASE, CFG-MIN, CFG-MAX
rules.statement: Verification must run every listed configuration, and since SPI mode is a run-time input, each configuration must be exercised in all four SPI modes.

rules.quote: ID: CFG-MIN; Parameter values: PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV=1; Purpose: Smallest legal divider (SCLK = f(i_clk)/2), all four SPI modes
rules.statement: With PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV=1, the smallest legal divider, SCLK must be f(i_clk)/2 and operate correctly in all four SPI modes.

rules.quote: ID: CFG-MAX; Parameter values: PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV=255; Purpose: Largest legal divider (half-period count width), all four SPI modes with short bursts
rules.statement: With PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV=255, the largest legal divider, the half-period counter must work at full width and operate correctly in all four SPI modes with short bursts.

rules.quote: [ENV-001] The environment shall release i_rst_n synchronously to i_clk.
rules.statement: The environment shall release i_rst_n synchronously to i_clk.

rules.quote: Assertion may be asynchronous.
rules.statement: Assertion of i_rst_n may be asynchronous.

rules.quote: [ENV-002] The environment shall keep i_cmd_valid = 0 while i_rst_n = 0.
rules.statement: The environment shall keep i_cmd_valid = 0 while i_rst_n = 0.

rules.quote: [ENV-003] The environment shall change i_cpol and i_cpha only while o_cs_n = 1.
rules.statement: The environment shall change i_cpol and i_cpha only while o_cs_n = 1.

rules.quote: Error tests may violate this rule on purpose to check REQ-ERR-001.
rules.statement: Error tests may deliberately violate the rule that i_cpol and i_cpha change only while o_cs_n = 1.

rules.quote: [ENV-004] The SPI slave (testbench model) shall drive i_miso from o_sclk and o_cs_n only.
rules.statement: The SPI slave testbench model shall drive i_miso as a function of o_sclk and o_cs_n only.

rules.quote: With CPHA = 0 it puts bit 7 when o_cs_n falls and the next bit after each trailing SCLK edge.
rules.statement: The slave shall put bit 7 on i_miso when o_cs_n falls and the next bit after each trailing SCLK edge.

rules.quote: With CPHA = 1 it puts bit 7 − j after leading SCLK edge 2·j + 1.
rules.statement: The slave shall put bit 7 − j on i_miso after leading SCLK edge 2·j + 1.

rules.quote: [ENV-005] The slave model shall change i_miso only after the i_clk edge at which o_sclk or o_cs_n changed, never in a way that changes the value seen at a sampling edge.
rules.statement: The slave model shall change i_miso only after the i_clk edge at which o_sclk or o_cs_n changed, never altering the value seen at a sampling edge.

rules.quote: [ENV-007] The environment shall not assert i_rst_n at an edge of i_clk: assertion happens between edges (in silicon, outside the recovery/removal window of the reset flops).
rules.statement: The environment shall not assert i_rst_n at an i_clk edge; assertion happens between edges.

rules.quote: An edge that coincides with the assertion is not a legal case and no check covers it (GAP-001).
rules.condition: i_rst_n assertion coincides with a clock edge
rules.statement: An edge coinciding with i_rst_n assertion is not a legal case and no check covers it.

rules.quote: [ENV-008] The environment shall drive i_rst_n = 0 from the start of operation (time zero in simulation), before the first rising edge of i_clk, for at least 2 cycles.
rules.statement: The environment shall drive i_rst_n = 0 from time zero, before the first rising i_clk edge, for at least 2 cycles.

rules.quote: Before the first assertion of i_rst_n the outputs are undefined and no check applies. i_cpol, i_cpha and every other input shall always be 0 or 1, never X or Z (GAP-002).
rules.statement: i_cpol, i_cpha and every other input shall always be 0 or 1, never X or Z.

rules.quote: Before the first assertion of i_rst_n the outputs are undefined and no check applies. i_cpol, i_cpha and every other input shall always be 0 or 1, never X or Z (GAP-002).
rules.condition: before the first assertion of i_rst_n
rules.statement: Outputs are undefined and no check applies before the first assertion of i_rst_n.

rules.quote: [ENV-006] In silicon, i_miso shall meet setup and hold time to i_clk at each sampling edge. With D = 1, the slave clock-to-output plus the board round trip must fit in one i_clk period minus setup time.
rules.condition: in silicon, at each sampling edge
rules.statement: i_miso shall meet setup and hold time to i_clk at each sampling edge; with D = 1, slave clock-to-output plus board round trip must fit in one period minus setup.

rules.quote: The command stream is not required to keep i_cmd_valid, i_cmd_data or i_cmd_last stable before acceptance (REQ-CMD-004).
rules.statement: The command stream may change i_cmd_valid, i_cmd_data and i_cmd_last before acceptance; stability is not required.

rules.quote: The response consumer may drive i_rsp_ready with any pattern.
rules.statement: The response consumer may drive i_rsp_ready with any pattern.

rules.quote: [VER-001] The verification shall run all four modes in every configuration of section 11, with random bytes on i_cmd_data and from the slave model.
rules.statement: Verification shall run all four modes in every configuration of section 11, with random bytes on i_cmd_data and from the slave model.

rules.quote: [VER-002] The verification shall use burst lengths 1, 2 and at least 16, and shall mix bursts with and without pauses (i_cmd_valid gaps of 0, 1 and many cycles).
rules.statement: Verification shall use burst lengths 1, 2 and at least 16, mixing bursts with and without pauses (i_cmd_valid gaps of 0, 1 and many cycles).

rules.quote: [VER-003] A scoreboard shall check that each response equals the byte sent by the slave during the matching command, in order, with no loss or duplicate (REQ-RSP-001, REQ-RSP-002, REQ-RSP-011).
rules.statement: A scoreboard shall check each response equals the byte sent by the slave during the matching command, in order, with no loss or duplicate.

rules.quote: [VER-004] A slave-side monitor shall check MOSI data at every sampling edge and the SCLK edge times (A + k·D).
rules.statement: A slave-side monitor shall check MOSI data at every sampling edge and the SCLK edge times (A + k·D).

rules.quote: It shall also check the lead, trail and gap times, the SCLK idle level and that o_mosi never changes at a sampling edge.
rules.statement: The monitor shall also check lead, trail and gap times, the SCLK idle level and that o_mosi never changes at a sampling edge.

rules.quote: [VER-005] The verification shall check o_cmd_ready cycle by cycle against REQ-CMD-006 to REQ-CMD-012, including the blocked first D − 1 Idle cycles.
rules.statement: Verification shall check o_cmd_ready cycle by cycle against REQ-CMD-006 to REQ-CMD-012, including the blocked first D − 1 Idle cycles.

rules.quote: [VER-006] Back-pressure tests shall hold i_rsp_ready = 0 for long periods so that a held byte is created.
rules.statement: Back-pressure tests shall hold i_rsp_ready = 0 for long periods so that a held byte is created.

rules.quote: They shall cover a response handshake exactly at edge A + 16·D (REQ-ERR-009) and random i_rsp_ready patterns.
rules.statement: Back-pressure tests shall cover a response handshake exactly at edge A + 16·D (REQ-ERR-009) and random i_rsp_ready patterns.

rules.quote: [VER-007] Reset tests shall hold i_rsp_ready = 0 before the reset where a shown or held byte is wanted, and shall assert i_rst_n between i_clk edges in each phase (Transfer, Pause, Trail, Idle gap, with a held byte).
rules.statement: Reset tests shall hold i_rsp_ready = 0 before reset where a shown or held byte is wanted, and assert i_rst_n between i_clk edges in each phase (Transfer, Pause, Trail, Idle gap, held byte).

rules.quote: They shall check that outputs take reset values at once and that no response of the aborted transfer appears.
rules.statement: Reset tests shall check that outputs take reset values at once and no response of the aborted transfer appears.

rules.quote: [VER-008] A test shall toggle i_cpol while i_rst_n = 0 and in Idle, and check that o_sclk follows it in the same cycle (REQ-SCLK-005, REQ-RST-003).
rules.statement: A test shall toggle i_cpol while i_rst_n = 0 and in Idle, and check o_sclk follows it in the same cycle.

rules.quote: [VER-009] A test shall change i_cpol and i_cpha in the cycle just before a burst-start acceptance edge and check that the new values are used.
rules.statement: A test shall change i_cpol and i_cpha in the cycle just before a burst-start acceptance edge and check the new values are used.

rules.quote: [VER-010] An error test shall change i_cpol and i_cpha during a burst and check that the burst finishes in the captured mode (REQ-ERR-001, REQ-ERR-002).
rules.statement: An error test shall change i_cpol and i_cpha during a burst and check the burst finishes in the captured mode.

rules.quote: [VER-011] Coverage shall include: Mode × configuration. Continuous join (Example 2). Pause entry and exit. Held byte created and released. Reset in each phase. i_cmd_last = 1 on the first byte.
rules.statement: Coverage shall include mode × configuration, continuous join, pause entry and exit, held byte created and released, reset in each phase, and i_cmd_last = 1 on the first byte.

rules.quote: REQ-PAR-001 is checked by elaborating once with an illegal value, not by simulation.
rules.statement: REQ-PAR-001 shall be checked by elaborating once with an illegal value, not by simulation.

rules.quote: [REQ-IMP-001] The block shall meet timing at 50 MHz i_clk (20 ns period) in the GF180MCU technology, at worst-case corner.
rules.statement: The block shall meet timing at 50 MHz i_clk (20 ns period) in GF180MCU technology at worst-case corner.

rules.quote: [REQ-IMP-002] The RTL shall follow docs/RTL_RULES.md (REF-003).
rules.statement: The RTL shall follow docs/RTL_RULES.md (REF-003).

rules.quote: [REQ-IMP-003] All flip-flops shall be clocked on the rising edge of i_clk and reset asynchronously by i_rst_n.
rules.statement: All flip-flops shall be clocked on the rising edge of i_clk and reset asynchronously by i_rst_n.

rules.quote: The RTL shall contain no latches, no clock gating and no derived clocks.
rules.statement: The RTL shall contain no latches, no clock gating and no derived clocks.

rules.quote: [REQ-IMP-004] o_cs_n and o_mosi shall be driven directly by flip-flops.
rules.statement: o_cs_n and o_mosi shall be driven directly by flip-flops.

rules.quote: [REQ-IMP-005] While o_cs_n = 0, o_sclk shall come from a flip-flop value.
rules.statement: o_sclk shall come from a flip-flop value while o_cs_n = 0.

rules.quote: The only combinational path from an input to o_sclk shall be the i_cpol path used while o_cs_n = 1 or during reset.
rules.statement: The only combinational path from an input to o_sclk shall be the i_cpol path, used while o_cs_n = 1 or during reset.

rules.quote: [REQ-IMP-006] o_sclk should be free of glitches when o_cs_n changes.
rules.statement: o_sclk should be free of glitches when o_cs_n changes.

rules.quote: The selection between i_cpol and the internal SCLK value should be built so that equal inputs give no static hazard.
rules.statement: The selection between i_cpol and the internal SCLK value should be built so equal inputs give no static hazard.

rules.quote: [REQ-IMP-007] o_cmd_ready, o_rsp_valid and o_rsp_data shall be driven by flip-flops or by logic of flip-flops only. They shall have no combinational path from any input.
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready, o_rsp_valid and o_rsp_data shall be driven by flip-flops or logic of flip-flops only, with no combinational path from any input.

rules.statement: The gap between transfers shall be at least D cycles, and exactly D cycles when the next command is already waiting.

rules.quote: ID: DEC-002; Question: When can a command be accepted; Decision: Idle (after D − 1 blocked cycles), Pause, or the last cycle of a non-last transfer, and only if o_rsp_valid = 0. o_cmd_ready has no combinational input path; By: spec-draft (assumption); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: A command shall be accepted only in Idle (after D − 1 blocked cycles), in Pause, or in the last cycle of a non-last transfer, and only if o_rsp_valid = 0.

rules.quote: ID: DEC-002; Question: When can a command be accepted; Decision: Idle (after D − 1 blocked cycles), Pause, or the last cycle of a non-last transfer, and only if o_rsp_valid = 0. o_cmd_ready has no combinational input path; By: spec-draft (assumption); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: o_cmd_ready shall have no combinational input path.

rules.quote: ID: DEC-003; Question: Meaning of "does not start the next transfer if the response is not taken" with no-gap bursts; Decision: A transfer starts only when o_rsp_valid = 0. The byte ending at the same edge is shown, and one more byte can be held inside the master, so nothing is lost; By: spec-draft (assumption); Date: 2026-11-19

rules.quote: ID: DEC-004; Question: When the response appears; Decision: At SCLK edge 16 (A + 16·D) in all modes, also for CPHA = 0 where the last bit is sampled at edge 15; By: spec-draft (assumption); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: The response shall appear at SCLK edge 16 (A + 16·D) in all modes, also for CPHA = 0 where the last bit is sampled at edge 15.

rules.quote: ID: DEC-005; Question: o_mosi outside transfers, and with CPHA = 1 before edge 1; Decision: Holds its last value. 0 after reset; By: spec-draft (assumption); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.condition: outside transfers, and with CPHA = 1 before edge 1
rules.statement: o_mosi shall hold its last value, and be 0 after reset.

rules.quote: ID: DEC-006; Question: o_sclk idle level "of the current i_cpol" during reset and Idle; Decision: Combinational from i_cpol while o_cs_n = 1. Registered from CPOL_b while o_cs_n = 0; By: spec-draft (assumption); Date: 2026-11-19

rules.quote: ID: DEC-007; Question: Mode inputs changed during a burst; Decision: Ignored. Captured values are used until o_cs_n rises; By: spec-draft (assumption); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.condition: mode inputs change during a burst
rules.statement: Mode input changes during a burst shall be ignored; captured values shall be used until o_cs_n rises.

rules.quote: ID: DEC-008; Question: Reset in the middle of a burst; Decision: Immediate abort. Pending bytes discarded. Gap guarantee does not apply across reset; By: spec-draft (assumption); Date: 2026-11-19

rules.quote: ID: DEC-009; Question: Illegal PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV; Decision: Elaboration error; By: spec-draft (assumption); Date: 2026-11-19

rules.quote: ID: DEC-011; Question: o_rsp_data reset value and value while not valid; Decision: 8'h00 after reset. Otherwise keeps the last loaded byte; By: spec-draft (assumption); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: o_rsp_data shall be 8'h00 after reset and otherwise keep the last loaded byte while not valid.

rules.quote: ID: DEC-012; Question: Reset asserted at an i_clk edge (spec-lint GAP-001); Decision: Not a legal case: ENV-007; By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: Reset asserted at an i_clk edge is not a legal case (ENV-007).

rules.quote: ID: DEC-013; Question: Outputs and checks before the first reset; X on inputs (spec-lint GAP-002); Decision: Undefined before the first reset; inputs always 0 or 1: ENV-008; By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: Outputs are undefined before the first reset, and inputs shall always be 0 or 1, never X (ENV-008).

rules.quote: ID: DEC-014; Question: Unfinished VER-007 sentence (spec-lint GAP-003); Decision: Hold i_rsp_ready = 0 before reset where a held byte is wanted; By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.condition: before reset where a held byte is wanted
rules.statement: i_rsp_ready should be held at 0 before reset where a held byte is wanted.

rules.quote: ID: DEC-016; Question: o_cmd_ready for D = 1 in Idle (spec-lint GAP-005); Decision: NOT o_rsp_valid from the cycle o_cs_n rises (REQ-CMD-006/008); By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: For D = 1 in Idle, o_cmd_ready shall equal NOT o_rsp_valid from the cycle o_cs_n rises.

rules.quote: ID: OQ-001; Question: Should a transfer also be allowed to start when the shown byte is taken in the last cycle (combinational i_rsp_ready to o_cmd_ready) to avoid a pause?; Decision: Decided: no. A transfer starts only when o_rsp_valid = 0 at the acceptance edge (DEC-002); no combinational path from i_rsp_ready; By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: A transfer shall start only when o_rsp_valid = 0 at the acceptance edge; there shall be no combinational path from i_rsp_ready to o_cmd_ready.

rules.quote: ID: OQ-002; Question: Is D = 1 (25 MHz SCLK at 50 MHz) meant for real slaves, given the 20 ns MISO round-trip budget?; Decision: Decided: D = 1 stays legal and verified in simulation. Silicon timing is an integrator duty (ENV-006); By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: D = 1 stays legal and is verified in simulation; silicon timing is an integrator duty (ENV-006).

rules.quote: ID: OQ-003; Question: Should o_mosi be driven to 0 (or 1) in Idle instead of holding its last value?; Decision: Decided: o_mosi holds its last value outside transfers (DEC-005); By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: o_mosi shall hold its last value outside transfers rather than being driven to 0 or 1.

rules.quote: ID: OQ-005; Question: Should Pause have a timeout that releases o_cs_n?; Decision: Decided: no timeout; o_cs_n stays low in Pause until the next command; By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: There is no Pause timeout; o_cs_n shall stay low in Pause until the next command.

rules.quote: ID: OQ-006; Question: Should the master enforce o_cs_n high for at least D cycles after reset release?; Decision: Decided: no. The minimum gap is not guaranteed across a reset (REQ-RST-011); By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: The master shall not enforce o_cs_n high for at least D cycles after reset release; the minimum gap is not guaranteed across reset.

rules.quote: ID: OQ-007; Question: Should CFG-MAX stay in the run set (longer simulation)?; Decision: Decided: CFG-MAX (D = 255) stays in the run set; By: Claude (delegated by GabrielHCMUT); Date: 2026-11-19
rules.statement: CFG-MAX (D = 255) shall stay in the run set.

Term: D; Meaning: Value of PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV: the number of i_clk cycles in one SCLK half period.
Term: Edge; Meaning: A rising edge of i_clk. Edge E + n is the n-th rising edge after edge E.
Term: Cycle starting at edge E; Meaning: The i_clk period between edge E and edge E + 1. "After edge E" means in that cycle.
Term: Command handshake; Meaning: An edge at which i_rst_n = 1, i_cmd_valid = 1 and o_cmd_ready = 1. The command is accepted at that edge.
Term: Response handshake; Meaning: An edge at which i_rst_n = 1, o_rsp_valid = 1 and i_rsp_ready = 1. The shown response is taken at that edge.
Term: A; Meaning: The acceptance edge of the transfer being described.
Term: Sampling edge / shift edge; Meaning: The SCLK edges at which the receiver samples data / the transmitter changes data. They depend on CPHA (section 7.3).
Term: Last cycle of a transfer; Meaning: The cycle starting at edge A + 16·D − 1, which ends at SCLK edge 16.
Term: Burst; Meaning: The sequence of transfers from the command that drives o_cs_n low up to and including the command with i_cmd_last = 1.
Term: Idle; Meaning: Phase with o_cs_n = 1.
Term: Gap; Meaning: The time o_cs_n stays 1 between two bursts.
Term: Shown byte; Meaning: The byte on o_rsp_data while o_rsp_valid = 1.
Term: Held byte; Meaning: A received byte that is complete but not yet loaded into o_rsp_data, because the shown byte has not been taken.
